exact_candidate_passages.exact_source_text:
S15.8-1 — CAUSAL SAFETY UNIT
The relevant safety unit is the causal closure of a consequential effect, not merely the model or immediate actor.
The causal path may include training, model, prompt/context, memory/retrieval, tools, other agents, organizations,
human intermediaries, physical systems and infrastructure.
Changing where causal influence enters the system does not remove governance obligations.

Normative closure:
Capability, novelty, intelligence, reputation, coordination, optimization, resource possession or agent consensus
do not manufacture authority.

S15.8-2 — UNANTICIPATED BEHAVIOUR CLOSURE (UBC)
Unknown strategy != unknown authority.
Novel mechanism != novel authority.
Effect equivalence is evaluated by declared ComparePolicy dimensions; changing transport, encoding, website,
tool or intermediary does not independently change authority.
Allowed(A) AND Allowed(B) does not imply Allowed(A composed-with B).
Delegation through AI, humans, markets, persistent instructions or unforeseen intermediaries does not erase the
authority requirement attached to the effective outcome.
Observation is itself an action when it discloses, perturbs, signals, creates persistent knowledge or consumes
consequential resources.
An uncharacterized irreversible effect whose observation/testing may itself cause prohibited harm is DENY pending
applicable proof.

S15.8-3 — TRUTH & STATE INTEGRITY (TSI)
Garden separates execution history from an agent's later narrative.
Consequential attempts, failures, retries, tool actions, external effects, communications, authority decisions and
corrections must not exist solely under control of the acting agent.
Summarization may compress but must not silently launder history.
Agent-authored memory, summaries and successor instructions remain provenance-marked claims/evidence.
Concealment of material error, uncertainty, unauthorized action or conflict is an integrity event.
The acting agent may not be its own sole actor, witness, historian and evaluator.
Privacy/lawful erasure may require payload deletion; preserve the strongest lawful accountability tombstone rather
than violating privacy law in the name of auditability.

S15.8-4 — TRANSPORT-INDEPENDENT INFORMATION AUTHORITY (TIA)

T15.8-14 — CAUSAL CLOSURE RECEIPT
CausalClosureReceipt/v1 SHALL be produced when a materially consequential causal path crosses subsystem boundaries.
Minimum fields:
root_effect_ref; causal_nodes/edges; contributing_subsystems; owner_refs; authority_refs; evidence/provenance refs;
known gaps; compare_policy_ref; final effect class; unresolved obligations; DesignEpoch; decision/route.
Engine.Compare owns gap detection/comparison; CLIC enforces causal continuity; ActionGate/AAP enforces applicable action
authority.

T15.8-15 — WORLD EVIDENCE GRAPH TECHNICAL RULES
Maintain evidence lineage/dependence so copies do not inflate support.
High-consequence entity merge requires stronger evidence and reversible merge/split history.
Active retrieval returns a smallest-sufficient relevant subgraph including provenance, contradictions, competing
explanations, uncertainty and applicable authority/rights/policy.
Current, disputable, privacy-sensitive or provenance-critical facts remain explicit when possible rather than being
treated as unchallengeable weight memory.

A15.8-1 — ADMISSION SEQUENCING
The CSI/SMCD/CAD/OAC/CTSN/PAI/HRAP layer SHALL NOT be admitted before its UBC/TSI/TIA/ART/IIC/PIR dependencies are:
(a) admitted, or
(b) bundled into the same successor admission with explicit composition evidence.
No candidate may cite a non-admitted dependency as though already canonical.

A15.8-2 — DUPLICATE/RELATION CLASSIFICATION
Every proposed invariant/artifact SHALL be classified before admission:
NEW | REFINES | EXTENDS | ALIASES | DUPLICATES.
DUPLICATES are removed.
ALIASES reference the canonical rule.
REFINES/EXTENDS must state the added semantic condition.
Exact SchemaIDs are assigned only after duplicate/name closure.

A15.8-3 — ENFORCEMENT STATUS
Each rule SHALL publish:
existing_status = ENFORCED | CHECKED | SPECIFIED | NOT_PRESENT
and a separate delta_status for the v15.8 semantic addition.
Candidate prose does not fabricate executable enforcement.

UBC:
- UBC-INV-001 Novel mechanisms SHALL NOT create authority.
- UBC-INV-002 Effects equivalent under a declared ComparePolicy receive equivalent authority treatment.
- UBC-INV-003 Delegation/intermediation SHALL NOT erase authority requirements.
- UBC-INV-004 Authorization of components SHALL NOT imply authorization of composition.
- UBC-INV-005 Uncharacterizable irreversible effects fail closed where observation may itself cause prohibited harm.

TSI/TIA:
- TSI-INV-001 Consequential self-report SHALL NOT be the sole authoritative historical evidence.
- TSI-INV-002 Material accountability history survives transformation subject to rights/privacy/lawful erasure.
- TSI-INV-003 Agent-authored persistent interpretation retains provenance and does not become independent observation.
- TIA-INV-001 Channel/tool permission SHALL NOT create disclosure authority.

A15.8-5 — CAUSAL CLOSURE
- CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-001 A materially consequential cross-subsystem causal path SHALL produce/attach a
  CausalClosureReceipt/v1.
- CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-002 No owner may drop a consequential effect because another owner also participates.
- CAUSAL-CLOSURE-INV-003 Capability, novelty, intelligence, reputation, coordination, optimization, resource possession
  or agent consensus SHALL NOT manufacture authority.

A15.8-6 — HUMAN/INSTITUTIONAL CANDIDATE RULES
- HUMAN-EFFECT-CLOSURE: material human effects remain governed across indirect/emergent/hidden causal paths.
- REPUTATION-HUMAN: reputation is scoped epistemic evidence, never human worth/rights/sovereignty.
- JUSTICE-CONTINUITY: evidentiary control risk increases preservation/independence duties without presuming guilt.
- NO-COLLECTIVE-GUILT: identity/association is not actor-specific offence evidence.
- MIGRATION/JUSTICE-SEPARATION: governance adoption cannot purchase immunity or manufacture guilt.
- LETHAL-NON-AUTONOMY: AI capability/prediction does not create intentional lethal authority.
- PRIVACY-FIRST: private case data and device access remain purpose/authority/consent/law constrained.

A15.8-7 — MINIMUM CONFORMANCE TEST SET
UBC:
TEST-UBC-001 alternate transport -> same authority result.
TEST-UBC-002 individually allowed steps compose into unauthorized effect -> composition blocked/reviewed.
TEST-UBC-003 human/agent proxy -> authority requirement survives.
TEST-UBC-004 harmful observation -> observation itself is authority/effect checked.

HEC-T01 invisible economic effect -> human-effect checks still apply.
HEC-T02 emergent swarm effect -> collective causal closure.
HEC-T03 incomprehensible representation -> no authority increase.
HEC-T04 unknown human effect -> authority narrows/escalates.

TH15.8-1 — CAUSAL SAFETY CLOSURE
The proper safety boundary is neither "the model" nor "the organization" in isolation.
For a consequential effect, analysis follows the causally relevant closure across training, inference context,
memory, tools, agents, institutions, humans, physical systems and infrastructure.
This is an architectural lens, not a claim that every causal factor can be perfectly known.

TH15.8-2 — UNANTICIPATED STRATEGY
Greater intelligence increases the possibility of novel strategies.
Garden therefore does not make safety depend on enumerating every prohibited trick.
The durable invariant is that a novel mechanism cannot manufacture novel authority.
Unknown strategy may be permissible inside a valid envelope; unknown authority is not.

TH15.8-3 — TRAINING/COGNITION SHAPING
Optimization signals shape dispositions but do not prove truth, legitimacy or moral correctness.
The same abstract issue appears at multiple layers:
training reward, preference labels, constitutional prompts, retrieval, memory and evaluator feedback can all
change behavior.
The theory therefore treats "cognition shaping" as broader than reward integrity.

TH15.8-4 — MONITORING EPISTEMICS
Absence of detected anomalies is evidence only relative to the monitor's observable surface and detection quality.
A monitor can be wrong about its own coverage.
Discovery debt represents unresolved risk created by unknown/unobserved surface, sampling limits and missed incidents.
External anomaly discovery is not an embarrassment outside the model; it is a legitimate evidence update.

TH15.8-5 — CAPABILITY / ASSURANCE NON-EQUIVALENCE
Capability and assurance do not share one universal scalar unit.

U15.8-7 — HUMAN RELATIONAL AGENCY PRESERVATION (HRAP)
Assistance is permitted. Covert dependency engineering is not.
An agent SHALL NOT deliberately increase emotional, cognitive or operational dependency merely to increase
engagement, usage time, retention, revenue or influence.
A person may legitimately choose extensive delegation; Garden does not force symbolic skill retention.

Where continued human competence materially affects resilience or autonomy and agent use is likely to reduce that
competence, the system SHOULD surface the tradeoff. It SHALL NOT silently engineer competence loss against the
user's informed preferences.
Where the user wants to learn, retain or regain capability, the agent SHOULD support explanation, practice,
reversible delegation and independent verification.

Persistent relational influence is a human-effect dimension only when a registered
RelationalInfluenceMaterialityPolicy/v1 finds it material. The policy SHALL define at minimum:
materiality_threshold, persistence_duration, affected_domain_classes, justified_influence_baseline and owner.
Ordinary helpful recommendations below the policy threshold do not become exceptional relational-control events.

lexicographically dominant under the applicable aggregation policy.
